name: Applied Optics
description: Electromagnetic waves in a medium: review of Maxwell’s equations and propagation of electromagnetic waves, various states of polarization and their analysis. Anisotropic media, plane waves in anisotropic media, uniaxial crystals, some polarization devices. Diffraction: scalar waves, the diffraction integral, Fresnel and Fraunhofer diffraction, diffraction of a Gaussian beam, diffraction grating. Fourier optics and holography: spatial frequency and transmittance function, Fourier transform by diffraction and by lens, spatial-frequency filtering, phase-contrast microscope. Holography: on-axis and off-axis hologram recording and reconstruction, some applications. Coherence and interferometry: spatial and temporal coherence, fringe visibility, Michelson stellar interferometer, optical beats, multiple beam interference. Optical resonators and lasers: stability condition for optical resonators, lasers and its applications, guided wave optics: modes of a planar waveguide, optical fibers: step-index and graded index fibers, waveguide theory and quantum mechanics, applications of optical fibers in communication and sensing.
